tools.name: apify_run_actor
tools.description: Run an Apify actor (web scraping / lead generation), wait for the run to finish, and return its dataset items as structured JSON.

input.description: The actor's input object (actor-specific). E.g. apify/web-scraper expects 'startUrls'; apify/google-search-scraper expects 'queries'.

wait_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the run to finish (default 120, max 600). Increase for large crawls.

max_items.description: Maximum dataset items to return (default 50, max 1000).
